# Additions to Esther Chapter 6 (Addition F) — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Codex Vaticanus, Additions to Esther F | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-DC/ADE_006_page_001.jpg

---

*[Addition F: Mordecai's interpretation of his dream (from Addition A) and the colophon of the book. Placed at the end of Greek Esther.]*

**6:1** And Mordecai said: "These things have-come-from God.

**6:2** For I-have-remembered the-dream which I-saw concerning these-matters; and not one thing has-gone-unfulfilled.

**6:3** The-small spring which became a river, and there-was light and sun and abundant water — this is Esther, whom the-king married and made queen.

**6:4** And the-two dragons — I am and Haman.

**6:5** And the-nations are those-who-gathered to-destroy the-name of-the Jews.

**6:6** And my nation, this is Israel, the-ones-who-cried out to God and were-saved. For the-Lord saved his people; the-Lord rescued us from all these evils; and God did great signs and wonders, which have-not-happened among the-nations.

**6:7** For this he-prepared two lots, one for the-people of God, and one for all the-nations.

**6:8** And these two lots came for the-appointed time and for the-day of judgment before God and for all the-nations.

**6:9** And God remembered his people and vindicated his inheritance.

**6:10** And they-will-observe these days in the-month of Adar, on the fourteenth and fifteenth of that month, with assembly and joy and gladness before God, throughout the-generations for-ever among his people Israel."

**6:11** [Colophon:] In the-fourth year of-the reign of Ptolemy and Cleopatra, Dositheus, who-said himself to-be a priest and Levite, and Ptolemy his son, brought this letter of Purim, which they-said Lysimachus son-of Ptolemy, one of those in Jerusalem, had-translated.
